priority_updates.title: Who will Aston Martin announce as Lance Stroll's teammate for the 2027 Formula One season?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Aston Martin's official announcement confirming its complete race-driver lineup for the 2027 Formula One season, corroborated by Formula One or reputable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the driver named alongside Lance Stroll in the first such announcement published by December 31, 2026. A confirmed race-seat contract is sufficient; the driver need not have competed in a 2027 race. Reserve, test, and advisory roles do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The driver's full name.

priority_updates.title: Who will Morocco's king appoint as prime minister following the country's 2026 parliamentary election?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Moroccan royal palace's public announcement, as documented in reliable news reporting. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first person appointed prime minister and tasked with forming a government following Morocco's 2026 parliamentary election. Accepted Answer Format : The appointee's name or commonly used surname.
watch_keywords: King Mohammed VI appoints prime minister

priority_updates.title: Which country will end China's gold-medal bid in men's football at the 2026 Asian Games?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official 2026 Asian Games men's football results, corroborated by reliable match reporting. Resolution : Identify the opposing national team in the match that eliminates China from contention for the men's football gold medal. Any subsequent bronze-medal match is excluded. If China wins gold, resolve to no country. Accepted Answer Format : The opposing country's name, or “None” if China wins gold.

priority_updates.title: Which court, if any, will grant Christa Pike a stay on the day of her scheduled September 30, 2026 execution?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth: Use the court's order or contemporaneous reporting to identify the court. Resolution Date: Resolve to the court that grants a stay of Pike's execution on September 30, 2026, before her scheduled execution time that day. Accepted Answer Format: Answer with its commonly used short name.
watch_keywords: Middle District of Tennessee Christa Pike
